setup.title: Filters of {channel}
setup.text: Pick which posts {channel} receives, in one of these two ways.

site.title: Option 1, from the site
site.steps:
1. Open the posts page with the button below and set your filters there.
2. Copy the address of the page from the address bar of your browser.
3. Click **{button}** and paste it.

manual.title: Option 2, here on Discord
manual.text: Pick the filters group by group, then save. Availability can only be set on the site, an availability already set is kept.

link.title: Paste the link
link.label: Link of the posts page
link.hint: Address copied from your browser on {site}, with your filters.

editor.hint: Open a group to change its filters. Nothing is applied before you save.
editor.minMonthsHint: At one of the picked levels, or at any level when none is picked.
editor.agentsHint: Posts must play every picked agent, {max} at most in total.

moderation.removed: The moderation channel is removed. Posts and reports are not sent anymore.

welcome.title: Scouting moderation
welcome.text: Every published or renewed post and every report shows up here. Members with {role} can remove, restore and tweet posts.
